title: Có giấy vệ sinh không?
summary: A bathroom follow-up phrase for asking for toilet paper directly and getting a yes/no answer, item, or gesture.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use this when the restroom is missing toilet paper or you need to ask before going in. It is a quick practical question, so the best delivery is direct, calm, and paired with a small gesture toward the stall, sink area, or paper holder.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Learn Có ... không? as the yes-or-no question frame, and keep giấy vệ sinh together as toilet paper.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Có giấy vệ sinh không? as the direct question for do you have toilet paper. Ask once, pause, and follow the answer or gesture. The phrase is short enough for a market, cafe, gas station, or small local restroom where a long explanation would feel clumsy.

sections.title: Why it matters
sections.body: This question is practical and quick. Keeping giấy vệ sinh together prevents the phrase from turning into misleading word cards. A traveler does not need to analyze each syllable here; the useful unit is the item you are asking for.

sections.title: Traveler insight
sections.body: The answer may be yes, no, a gesture toward the paper, or a short alternative. Follow pointing first, then ask again only if the next step is unclear. If the person points outside the restroom, they may be showing you where paper is kept rather than answering with a full sentence.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi dùng nhà vệ sinh được không?
phrases.pronunciation: toy zoong nya veh sinh dook khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it before or after finding the bathroom if paper is missing. It is especially useful before you go in, because many places answer with a gesture or hand you the item directly.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi rửa tay ở đây được không?
phrases.english: Can I wash my hands here?
phrases.pronunciation: toy zoo-ah tai uh day dook khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: For travelers, giấy vệ sinh should be learned as toilet paper, not split into separate unrelated words. That keeps the phrase practical and avoids false word-by-word meanings.

sections.title: Local tip
sections.body: Ask directly and follow gestures. People may simply point you toward the paper, hand you some, or show another place to get it. A quick cảm ơn after the handoff keeps the exchange warm.

sections.title: Explore next
